choose.otherwise: SELECT author_id, max_recipients AS capacity, CASE WHEN share_status != 0 OR available_until < SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS closed FROM ingredient_share WHERE share_id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
